name: 2-Egg + Chicken Scramble
recipeText:
2-Egg + Chicken Scramble (serves 1)
2 large eggs
100g cooked skinless chicken breast, diced
1 tsp olive oil, for the pan
sources: USDA large egg: 72 cal, 6g protein, 4g fat, 0g carb (https://www.recipal.com/ingredients/16120-nutrition-facts-calories-protein-carbs-fat-usda-eggs-whole-raw)
USDA cooked skinless chicken breast: 165 cal, 31g protein, 3.6g fat per 100g (https://calceat.app/blog/calories-in-chicken-breast/)
Olive oil ~1 tsp (1/3 tbsp): ~40 cal, 4.7g fat (standard USDA value, 1 tbsp = 120 cal / 14g fat)

name: Isopure Shake w/ Oat Milk
recipeText:
Isopure Shake w/ Oat Milk (serves 1)
1 scoop Isopure Zero Carb protein powder
1 cup Califia Farms Oat Barista Blend
sources: Isopure Zero Carb: 100 cal, 25g protein, 0g carb, 0g fat per scoop (https://www.amazon.com/Isopure-Protein-Powder-Isolate-Flavor/dp/B000E95HP0)
Califia Farms Oat Barista Blend: 130 cal, 2g protein, 7g fat, 13g carb per cup (https://www.mynetdiary.com/food/calories-in-oat-milk-barista-blend-by-califia-farms-cup-26973111-0.html)

name: Oikos + Isopure Yogurt Bowl
recipeText:
Oikos + Isopure Yogurt Bowl (serves 1)
1 cup (5.3oz) Oikos Triple Zero vanilla Greek yogurt
1 scoop Isopure Zero Carb protein powder, mixed in
sources: Oikos Triple Zero vanilla: 100 cal, 15g protein, 0g fat, 10g carb per 5.3oz cup (https://www.walmart.com/ip/Oikos-Triple-Zero-15g-Protein-0g-Added-Sugar-Fat-Free-Vanilla-Greek-Yogurt-Cups-5-3-oz-4-Count/49028504)
Isopure Zero Carb: 100 cal, 25g protein, 0g carb, 0g fat per scoop

name: Grilled Chicken & Oats Bowl
recipeText:
Grilled Chicken & Oats Bowl (serves 1)
150g cooked skinless chicken breast
1/2 cup dry rolled oats, cooked
1 tbsp olive oil
sources: USDA cooked skinless chicken breast: 165 cal, 31g protein, 3.6g fat per 100g (scaled to 150g)
Rolled oats, dry, 1/2 cup: ~150 cal, 5g protein, 27g carb, 3g fat (standard USDA reference)
Olive oil, 1 tbsp: 120 cal, 14g fat (standard USDA reference)

name: Oats & Almond Butter Bowl
recipeText:
Oats & Almond Butter Bowl (serves 1)
1/2 cup dry rolled oats, cooked
1 tbsp almond butter
1 medium banana, sliced
sources: Rolled oats, dry, 1/2 cup: ~150 cal, 5g protein, 27g carb, 3g fat
Almond butter, 1 tbsp (~16g): ~98 cal, 3.4g protein, 3g carb, 9g fat (standard USDA reference)
Banana, medium (118g): ~105 cal, 1.3g protein, 27g carb, 0.4g fat (standard USDA reference)

name: Banana Almond Butter Snack
recipeText:
Banana Almond Butter Snack (serves 1)
1 medium banana
1 tbsp almond butter
sources: Banana, medium: ~105 cal, 1.3g protein, 27g carb, 0.4g fat
Almond butter, 1 tbsp: ~98 cal, 3.4g protein, 3g carb, 9g fat

name: Protein Banana Shake
recipeText:
Protein Banana Shake (serves 1)
1 scoop Isopure Zero Carb protein powder
1 medium banana
1 cup Califia Farms Oat Barista Blend
sources: Isopure Zero Carb: 100 cal, 25g protein, 0g carb, 0g fat per scoop
Banana, medium: ~105 cal, 1.3g protein, 27g carb, 0.4g fat
Califia Farms Oat Barista Blend: 130 cal, 2g protein, 7g fat, 13g carb per cup

name: Chicken & Egg Power Bowl
recipeText:
Chicken & Egg Power Bowl (serves 1)
200g cooked skinless chicken breast
2 large eggs
1 tbsp olive oil
sources: USDA cooked skinless chicken breast: 165 cal, 31g protein, 3.6g fat per 100g (scaled to 200g)
USDA large egg: 72 cal, 6g protein, 4g fat, 0g carb (x2)
Olive oil, 1 tbsp: 120 cal, 14g fat
